release.name: Graph Intelligence and Deep Whole-System Learning
release.boundary: Repository learning remains evidence-bound, incremental and human-reviewable; it is not autonomous truth adjudication or opaque model training.

semantic_coverage.description: The v1 semantic model maps the implemented components, interfaces, entities, relations, runtime flows, deployment boundaries and key risks represented by the reviewed snapshot.

repository_inventory.description: A deterministic recursive inventory and unmodelled-surface report is part of the v1.1 roadmap but is not represented as complete in this first increment.

live_external_state.description: Mutable settings, infrastructure and service state remain separate from repository learning and require direct inspection.

capabilities.name: Cross-model node search
capabilities.purpose: Find components, external systems or dependencies by name, purpose, layer or source path and open a view that contains the selected node.

capabilities.name: Upstream and downstream impact focus
capabilities.purpose: Derive direct, upstream and downstream context exclusively from the existing typed relation graph.

capabilities.name: Accessible zoom, pan and fit
capabilities.purpose: Navigate dense graph views without mutating the underlying architecture model.

capabilities.name: Relation evidence inspector
capabilities.purpose: Expose the model's real relation label, type, status and confidence while a node is in focus.

capabilities.name: Deterministic repository domain inventory
capabilities.purpose: Classify source, tests, workflows, documentation, schemas and operational surfaces and report what is not yet mapped.

capabilities.name: Incremental intelligence delta
capabilities.purpose: Compare a new repository commit with the prior baseline and update only affected model facts, notes, views and tests.

evidence_contract.summary: No repository observation becomes system knowledge unless its source, baseline, status, confidence and review boundary are explicit.
prohibited_collapses: source presence does not prove live deployment
documentation does not override current executable evidence
draft or local records do not become canonical evidence
inference does not become confirmed fact without new evidence

delta_protocol: Pin the new repository commit and tree before analysis.
Inventory changed paths and classify affected system domains.
Re-evaluate only model facts whose evidence set changed.
Preserve prior facts and documentation drift rather than silently rewriting history.
Regenerate synchronized JSON, Obsidian notes and graph views.
Run structural, source-path, accessibility and production-route validation.
Record unresolved external state as UNKNOWN.
